commit.message:
py3d 1.9.0: WARN_COMPONENT_COVERAGE reads the union of the components, on Geometry, View and Fire (#54)

_check_component_coverage read the Geometry LOD only when it held a selection
named exactly 'Component01', and compared that selection alone with the whole
LOD. It fired whenever Component01 held fewer points or faces than the LOD, as
on a healthy LOD with several components (each of the Pack's door samples,
LFPowerGrid's six-component gate_and.p3d). It never read a LOD without an
exact Component01, lowercase components included, although those collide
like Component01 in game (killer #2). It counted proxy triangles and loose
points as uncovered, and did not run on View or Fire.

Owner's choices (2026-10-02):
- coverage is the union of every selection named "Component" and a number,
  in any case (#46's _COMPONENT_NAME_RE, fullmatch);
- it runs on the Geometry, View and Fire LODs;
- points that no face uses are ignored;
- it stays a WARN.

Implementation: it counts the faces that are not proxy triangles (#46's
_proxy_triangle_faces) and that no component holds, and the points those
faces use that none holds. A nonzero weight counts as membership. It raises
one finding per LOD. A LOD with no component is left to ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING;
one whose component selections are all empty is reported with every face
counted. It ships under #46's unreleased 1.9.0; no new wheel.

dayz-p3d-audit killer #8 and references/killers-detail.md section 8 say
which py3d version does what. They name proxy triangles and points that no
face uses as left out, and call the collision of a face outside every
component expected, not measured (measured only for a LOD with no component
at all). The replaced text is quoted in their dated notes. CHANGELOG
[Unreleased] has the entry; the py3d README test count is 341 / 334.

Evidence:
- py3d suite: 334 passed, 11 skipped. The 25 new tests, run against the
  base module: 20 fail, 5 pass (guards; the fractional-weight test instead
  fails on a mutant that counts only weight 1).
- Read-only impact run on 414 unique MLODs through P3D._scan_v12_findings:
  78 findings on 39 Geometry LODs before, 3 after; no other finding changed.
- dayz-model-preflight and dayz-vehicle-proxy-contract suites green.
- packctl validate and gate PASS.

Review: Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of 2 rounds. Round 1: SOUND-WITH-FIXES
(three P2, fixed). Round 2: SOUND.

commit.message:
py3d 1.9.0: ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING flags a collision LOD with no component, whatever the name's case (#46)

Up to 1.8.0 _check_component_naming ran on the Geometry LOD alone and raised
ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING on a lowercase component01, which in game collides
exactly like Component01 (dayz-p3d-audit killer #2, #42). Now, on the
owner's choices of 2026-10-02:

- ERR_COMPONENT_NAMING: a Geometry, View or Fire LOD with faces outside its
  proxy triangles and no selection whose name starts with "component", any
  case. The message states the measured case (no component in any collision
  LOD: collision lost silently) and that one LOD missing it alone was not
  measured.
- WARN_COMPONENT_NAMING only when every component-like name is irregular
  (Component_01; matched with fullmatch, so a trailing newline is irregular).
- A proxy triangle is a proxy-named selection holding 1 triangle and, as its
  3 points, that triangle's corners; any other shape stays collision geometry.
- No faces, or only proxy triangles: no finding. An empty component
  selection still counts as present (documented; left to the coverage task).
- py3d 1.9.0 in source; no new wheel (the pinned 1.8.0 keeps the old check).

Tests: 61 in test_s2_validate12.py, 19 failing on the 1.8.0 library; five
mutants each killed. Impact on 414 unique MLODs: 94 errors -> 1, nothing new.
Skill notes (dayz-p3d-audit, dayz-vehicles, dayz-clothing), a knowledge note,
README, KNOWN-ISSUES and CHANGELOG updated; source-map resealed.

commit.message:
py3d: ERR_WINDING_VS_NORMALS says winding and normals disagree, not which is wrong (#37)

The finding read every disagreement between winding and stored normals as
faces wound backwards and prescribed face.vertices.reverse() on every face;
the README called that fix always correct. The finding only says the two
disagree: on the Rule 12 in-game fixture, the correct export with its normals
turned and the same export with its faces turned raise the same finding with
the same text and need opposite fixes, and either fix silences it (the wrong
one leaves the model inside-out). Reversing every face did that to two
Blender exports in DayZDiag (dayz-p3d-audit, "Absolute winding check").

The message now gives an order that works whichever side is wrong: settle
the winding first, normals untouched (visual LOD: per closed shell, made
coherent, then reversed whole if its signed volume by winding has the wrong
sign; collision LOD: reverse the faces pointing outward in each convex
component; never a vertices[1]/[2] swap), then negate each corner normal
still against its face (an entry a kept corner also uses gets a negated
copy). The README gives the same order in three steps and says neither
winding check sees faces and normals turned together. Finding code and
severity unchanged; py3d stays 1.8.0, no new wheel (the installed 1.8.0
still prints the old message). Eight tests on the measured fixture; negative
controls: each earlier message and each mutated sign phrase fails at least
one.

Reviewed by Codex gpt-6.1-sol, cap of two rounds set before round 1: both
rounds UNSOUND (shared pool entries, a shell with one reversed face, concave
components, an odd face turned with its normal, whole-face negation on a
first-corner reading, the normal budget, untested signs); every finding
reproduced and fixed, round 2 after the cap and verified mechanically.
packctl gate PASS on the merged head d118300 (builds byte-identical, 313
packctl and 283 py3d tests) and CI SUCCESS. Merged ahead of release PR #36
on the owner's decision; this entry stays under [Unreleased].

Killer #1 ("Inverted Face Winding") said a broken Geometry LOD has its normals pointing inward
and fixed it by swapping vertices[1]/[2] so the LOD matches the Visual LOD. Rule 12 (measured in
game 2026-10-01) stores the cross product and the normals both inward, and the swap turns a quad
into a crossed face. Check A called any 5-95 % MIXED reading a CRITICAL real bug, which
contradicted "Absolute winding check" rule 2.

- Killer #1 (SKILL.md index, references/killers-detail.md) is now a collision LOD wound opposite
  to the Visual LOD: the relative check audit_p3d.py runs through py3d P3D.validate()
  (ERR_WINDING_INVERTED), read as a trigger, not the verdict.
  - Rule 18's per-component check decides once its prerequisites hold: every non-proxy face in
    a ComponentNN selection, components closed and convex. Every face must point inward;
    otherwise the check is unresolved, never healthy.
  - face.vertices.reverse() fixes each face that reads outward. Its normals are negated only
    when they agreed with the outward winding.
  - A collision LOD is never reversed to match the Visual LOD (rule 7).

  or group repaired from the Check A table. The SUB_BRZ co-driver door, verified in game, reads

  follow two conventions. Check B finds one stray edge; with it cut, all 23 welded components
  orient as one group. The census without the 144 near-twin faces is unchanged.
